00-spec.notes: Specification defines three independent pieces: (1) ProveedorDeInferencia trait in hexcell-core with generar returning impl Future<Output = Result<RespuestaDeInferencia, Self::Error>> + Send (hand-written to avoid async_fn_in_trait lint on 1.92.0), plus ProveedorSimulado deterministic implementation using FNV-1a fingerprint of request (not echo, not rand, not system clock), enabling AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4 (processor consumes through trait, not concrete type, and provider reply is distinguished from fixed value); (2) ordered shutdown via Apagado module registering SIGTERM/SIGINT with tokio::sync::watch, Motor::ejecutar biased select over signal and recv with per-event work in branch body (never cancelled mid-flight), 10s drain limit checked between events (not wrapping drain in timeout), WAL checkpoint on sessions.db, exit 0, all <30s, enabling AC-5, AC-6, AC-7; (3) structured JSON logging by hand (no tracing/log crate) with evento (&'static str), id_evento, id_conversacion, latencia_ms, and detalle field only for process-internal text, enabling AC-8, AC-9. All 12 ACs covered; all constraints satisfied (hexcell-core dependency-free, no async fn in trait, motor consumes through trait, SIGTERM drain bounded temporally not with timeout wrapper, no message content in logs by construction via type system).
